SF2 (rr2) paths are derived with the casing rule that reproduces every SF1 path and the SF2 path seen in the log (natives/STM/Text/rr2/Message/Eng/RR2_dm0000_ENG.msg.23). SF2 (rr2) and SF3 (rr3) paths were checked against the REFramework log of 2026-11-23 (1,480 paths; 6 rr3 names with uppercase hex digits, e.g. RR3_npc_st510A_ENG, taken from the log).
